column1: # 6.3 / D13 — what travels with this repo, per project.
# One line per project: <repo folder><TAB><absolute project root>
# sync.sh mirrors these files from each root, and skips any that do not exist:
#     CLAUDE.md                      the project's rules (gitignored in the project)
#     .claude/settings.local.json    permission rules added by clicking allow
# The copies under project-rules/ are COPIES. The live files are the source of truth.
# Skills are NOT here on purpose — they are not gitignored, so they travel in the
# project's own repo. See SETUP-PLAN.md § 'Project rules are separate'.
